description: This file defines a Migrator class and associated functions for managing database schema migrations in the Mattermost server, including creating migration plans, applying migrations, and initializing migration engine with PostgreSQL driver.

classes.name: Migrator
classes.description: Handles database migration operations including creating plans, applying migrations, and closing the migration engine.

classes.name: SqlStore
classes.description: Represents the SQL store with methods for initializing migration engine and managing database connection.

methods.name: NewMigrator
methods.description: Creates a new Migrator instance with database settings, logger, and dry run option.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the migration engine and the SQL store.

methods.name: GetFileName
methods.description: Generates a filename for the migration plan based on current and target database schema versions.

methods.name: GeneratePlan
methods.description: Generates a migration plan to upgrade the database schema.

methods.name: MigrateWithPlan
methods.description: Applies a given migration plan to the database.

methods.name: DowngradeMigrations
methods.description: Creates and applies a migration plan to downgrade specific versions.
